messages:
Lina - Account Exec: Heads-up: Ben's procurement pulled our vendor review and flagged BCP/DR specifics. They need empirical RTO/RPO values, backup retention & encryption details, failover playbook (redacted ok), and any recent DR exercises with timings. Can we bundle and send a gated link by Thursday close?
Sam - Solutions Eng: I can compile the tech one-pager. Short facts: Dedicated (reserved) endpoints use active-primary + warm standby in secondary region. Measured during last drill: control-plane failover start -> edge switch = 3m10s, model cold-start + KV reload = 4m20s, observed total RTO = 7m30s. Test date: 2026-02-09.
Priya - InfoSec: We'll need to separate what is public vs NDA-only. Public: SOC2 attestation summary + CAIQ alignment spreadsheet. NDA-only: full SOC2 report, runbook excerpts, raw test logs. Also require confirmation that backups use AES-256 and KMS with customer-key option for Dedicated/Private.
Ben - Acme IT (customer): Procurement specifically wants proof of "measured" numbers, not estimates. If you can provide the test run log (redacted) showing timestamps that helps. Also need the RPO statement for hosted: can you confirm hourly snapshot window and any recent deviations?
Sam - Solutions Eng: Hosted backups: incremental snapshots hourly, full daily, standard retention 30 days; cross-region replication within 1 hour via CRR. Operational RPO target for hosted is 1 hour; Dedicated supports streaming replication for near-zero RPO if configured. No incidents of backup failure in last 90 days.
Lina - Account Exec: @Ben we can provide a short evidence pack + schedule a live POC failover so you can observe. Do you want a 1-week or 2-week observational window?
Ben - Acme IT (customer): Prefer 2-week POC (baseline + failover). Also need pricing delta for reserved two-week trial vs on-demand. Can you include an estimate for expected token spend?
Kai - Legal: I'll review what we plan to share. Please include the SLA extract for Dedicated (uptime, measurement window, credits) and the clause about evidence provision under NDA. We shouldn't include internal contact emails in shared logs.
Sam - Solutions Eng: Draft SLA excerpt for sharing: "Redwood Dedicated: Monthly Availability SLA of 99.95%. Remedies: tiered service credits as defined in Section 4.4 of the Master Services Agreement. Customers may request DR evidence under an executed NDA."
Priya - InfoSec: Example redacted log snippet we can share (NDA-only):
```
2026-02-09T10:07:12Z - initiate failover request
2026-02-09T10:10:22Z - traffic routed to standby (95% cutover)
2026-02-09T10:14:42Z - KV-store warmed to operational threshold
```
Priya - InfoSec: Note: snapshots are encrypted at-rest with AES-256 and encrypted server-side via AWS KMS. For Dedicated and Private, we support customer-managed KMS keys. Snapshots are write-once for 14 days by default; WORM/immutability can be extended per contract.
ci-bot: dr/test-run-20260209: completed successfully - artifact: s3://ci-artifacts/dr/2026-02-09/failover-report.json
Lina - Account Exec: I'll prepare the package: 1) 1-page RTO/RPO summary with measured numbers + method, 2) public SOC2 attestation link, 3) CAIQ mapping URL, 4) redacted runbook excerpt & log (NDA-only), 5) SLA excerpt. Target Thursday EOD.
Sam - Solutions Eng: POC plan (summary): - Provision small Dedicated pool - 48h baseline synthetic traffic (latency, throughput, error rates) - Controlled failover to secondary region during week 2 - Capture metrics and provide dashboard export + logs. Available windows: Mar 22-26 or Apr 5-9.
Ben - Acme IT (customer): Let's aim for Apr 5-9. Also: rough cost estimate for trial: Reserved small pool + burst buffer ~ $5,200 for 2 weeks. Add-on: Private deployment quote separately.
Priya - InfoSec: Reminder: redact any customer identifiers from logs. I'll produce a short redaction checklist.
Kai - Legal: I'll QC the redactions and sign off on shareable docs. Lina, please route the NDA link to Ben; once executed, Sam/Priya will share the NDA-only artifacts.
Lina - Account Exec: Action items: Sam -> one-pager + logs redacted; Priya -> redaction checklist + CAIQ pointer; Kai -> confirm SLA excerpt & NDA template; I'll send NDA and pricing. Target: deliver gated package by Thu EOD.
Ben - Acme IT (customer): Excellent. We'll review NDA quickly and confirm POC window. Thanks everyone.
